To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a computational scheme for simulating filtration of diesel soot particles in DPF and have confirmed that it can reproduce the improvement of the filtration performance caused by the soot particle accumulation in DPF.

the developed scheme is able to simulate the gas flow and soot filtration in DPF, and the filtration of the soot particles in the porous structure is dominated by the Brownian diffusion at the early stage and the interception at the later stage.

the filtration efficiency has a minimum at around particle diameter of 0.3 micrometer, and that the developed scheme reproduces the filtration efficiency and the back pressure as a function of soot loading.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the filtration efficiency of soot particles, which is an important issue for the development of SiC-DPF.
the development of the computational scheme for the gas-particle flows, and the application to the filtration of soot in DPF.
the filtration of nanoparticles in porous media.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper has developed a computational scheme that can be applied to simulating gas-particles flow in DPF.
the developed scheme is a powerful tool for simulating the filtration performance of the DPF.
the developed scheme is useful for the analysis of filtration of soot in DPF.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the developed scheme is useful to evaluate filtration efficiency of DPF and to optimize its structure.
the developed computational scheme is applicable to simulating the filtration process of soot particles by DPF, and it is useful for the optimization of the design of the DPF.
this scheme would be a promising approach to the simulation of the filtration performance of SiC-DPF.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the developed scheme is applicable to the simulation of the filtration process in DPF, and it is useful for understanding the mechanism and predicting the performance of the DPF.
the filtration efficiency of SiC-DPF is enhanced with the accumulation of sooted particles, while the back pressure is increased.
the developed simulation scheme enables to investigate the filtration performance of DPF in the whole range of the particle diameter, which is difficult in the conventional experiment.
